preparation: x-axis guide j=1..N: channel0=(0,0,4), channel14=(0,0,0); source j=0: channel0=(0,1,2), channel14=(0,-1,2); all other triples (0,0,2)
signal: activation front with first nonzero b at successive prepared receivers at t=j; not a localized translating full-state packet
clock: receiver projection (a,b) at channel0 cycles (0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,0) after arrival while record lasts; channel14 has negative counters
memory: local bit M=1 iff receiver channel0.r=0 and channel14.r=4; M=0 otherwise; no log used as memory
click: read-only rising edge M(t-1)=0 and M(t)=1

controls.gap: remove prepared pair at j=3 before run
controls.r_plus_one: change receiver j=2 channel0 initial r from4 to5 before run

success: all unperturbed guide cases match first arrival, projected clock and full local memory window, each including >=32 consecutive record ticks; no-source/source-only/gap controls have no target click; all full-state inverse audits exact
failure: report every mismatch; perturbation failure limits robustness rather than falsifying ideal seed result
